Diera

Overview

Diera is a sorceress close to Governor Valrasian. She supplies magic through Karansul and installed the traps guarding the governor’s collection. She repeatedly warns Zak away from the missing Princess. Grey Leaf’s account of the white-haired cloaked figure helps expose her involvement, and Lu-a-Jalla later identifies Diera as her captor, driven by jealousy over the governor. [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]

Arrival on Ingos and the missing Princess

On Ingos, Zak first crosses the hostile countryside to reach the city. Tilvar tells him about the missing young woman known locally as the Princess and the reward offered for finding her. Governor Valrasian takes a personal interest in her, while Diera discourages the search. The hunter Sver the Trapper provides a concrete lead: another investigator, the Snoop from the capital, had followed the same trail before disappearing east of the city. Finding his body changes the search for a missing girl into an investigation of murder. [6, 7, 8, 9, 2, 10, 11]

Diera and the locked mines

At the Green Clan’s new home, Grey Leaf describes the supposed man in grey as a white-haired woman. Zak identifies Diera, whose own traps protected the stolen collection. Her urgent warnings against the abandoned mines reinforce his suspicion. Tilvar explains that the governor holds the key. Karansul suggests winning it with a gold nugget and gives access to a dangerous pit, concealing the tigers that drove out its workers; Sver warns Zak of the trap. Zak obtains the nugget and presents it to the collector-governor as a business prospect. Valrasian releases the mine key, opening the way past Diera’s mercenaries. [4, 3, 12, 13, 14, 15, 16, 17]

Lu-a-Jalla beneath the mines

The former punishment cell is empty. Zak follows the trail deeper into the Forbidden Catacombs until he finds Lu-a-Jalla, who first mistakes him for another captor. She has escaped the mercenaries and found protection through the ancient treaty between Joons and Wormheads. She rejects the nickname Princess and explains that Diera imprisoned her out of jealousy over the governor. Zak falls in love with her, but she remains faithful to At-Zako, who drew the Joon Curse away from her. Zak promises to respect that bond. They return to Tka-Rik, and the next mission becomes the search for her missing beloved on Suslanger. [18, 19, 20, 21, 5]
